title: Verify: No standalone RoundBadge or Countdown in App unit tests
summary: Unit tests proving the old badge and countdown are gone from App.
description: Assert a single timer inside the header and no App.tsx references to the removed components.

steps.action: Create the file with // @vitest-environment jsdom; vi.mock('../src/api/client') with getCurrentRound resolving roundFixture (from tests/fixtures/api.ts, mirroring the Round type in src/api/client.ts). Test 1: render App, click Begin, await findByText(roundFixture.id), assert screen.getAllByRole('timer') has length 1 and that it is within screen.getByRole('banner'). Test 2: read src/App.tsx with readFileSync and assert it does not match /RoundBadge|Countdown/.
steps.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/appNoLegacyHeader.test.tsx
